groups.name: memory
groups.description: SQLite-backed work memory experiments for Lua skills.

tools.name: vulcan-work-memory-sqlite-test
tools.description: Create or reuse the shared work-memory SQLite database under __database/vulcan-work-memory, insert one test row, and return the latest database state.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Optional note content inserted into the test table. When omitted, the tool writes a stable default message.

tools.prompt: Use this to verify that Lua can create and use the shared work-memory SQLite database under __database/vulcan-work-memory.
